decision: NO-GO on frozen textless-target OmniVoice under the prespecified OMX-01 protocol. Positive TTS controls pass; no adapter training or seed/CFG/temperature tuning.
inferences: Finite non-silent audio and distinct file hashes do not demonstrate Italian, novelty or narrative coherence.

Official target-conditioned Italian succeeds while all 18 empty-target cases fail the fluent-Italian criterion. This isolates the failure to the tested empty-target setup rather than a universal Italian TTS failure.
Human silence/nonvoice judgments coexist with RMS above 1e-5: nonzero energy is not evidence of speech.
Four voice-empty cases are rated partial mixed-language repetitions; none are rated novel. A causal explanation for the echo is not established.
This result does not establish impossibility of retraining OmniVoice, or comparative TTS superiority of Qwen.
implementation_corrections: Tiny random-weight test vocabulary was initially too small for the acoustic MASK ID; fixture corrected before GPU inference.
